description: This file contains implementations of big number exponentiation functions, particularly modular exponentiation, used in cryptographic computations. It includes functions like BN_mod_exp and BN_mod_mul, which perform modular exponentiation and multiplication on large integers, often used in SSL/TLS cryptography.

methods.name: int BN_mod_mul(BIGNUM * ret,BIGNUM * a,BIGNUM * b,const BIGNUM * m,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs modular multiplication of large numbers: (a * b) mod m.

methods.name: int BN_mod_exp(BIGNUM * r,BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * p,const BIGNUM * m,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation: (a^p) mod m, choosing different algorithms based on compile-time conditions.
